Quick Actions

To cancel your subscription

  1. Log in to your account here: Customer Login
  2. Open Cancel Subscription and confirm.

Your subscription stays active until the end of the billing period you already paid for.

To upgrade your plan

  1. Log in to your account here: Customer Login
  2. Pick the new plan under Upgrade options and complete the secure checkout.

To update your plan details (website, service area, etc)

  1. Log in to your account and click Update business information.
  2. Save your changes - they apply right away.

Prefer email?

Write to us directly at support@unirab.com from the address associated with your order, and include your order ID where possible.

Business hours

Monday - Friday, 7 AM - 4 PM ET. We acknowledge every message within one business day.

Partnerships
